item.name: Camp_Generators
item.description: Camp generators and their built-in fuel gauges.
item.readyForNextPerson: No visible fuel leak is present. Fuel caps remain closed and controls remain in the state set by the authorized operator.
item.ifNotReady: Keep people away and immediately tell the Fuel Lead, Dominatrix, and a Black Rock Ranger about any fuel leak or spill. Do not refuel or repair a generator unless authorized.
